title: Pastrimi waste-workers' wage strike and reported March 13–14 activity
description: February-language searches returned reports of Pastrimi workers' strike and wage dispute in Pristina around March 13–14, outside this unit. Preserve as a lead for March research only; no February protest or qualifying public gathering is asserted.
open_questions: Did workers hold a public protest gathering in March, distinct from an internal work stoppage?
Was attendance at a specific site at least 50 simultaneously, and was the demand directed to Kosovo state or municipal policy?
